# LDBG

> LDBG is a free falling-block RPG you play in your browser. Every line you clear hits a monster. Gather on the Farm, craft gear, fight through Greenshore and the Red Desert, and duel other players.

LDBG is a falling-block puzzle game and an RPG at once. You stack falling pieces and clear lines as in any competitive stacker, and every line you clear does something in the RPG: on the Farm it gathers materials, in a dungeon it strikes the monster in front of you, and in the Arena it hits another player. Your account keeps your character's level, gear, materials and unlocks between runs. It is made with the Godot engine by an independent developer and is in early beta.

- Play free in a desktop browser: https://play.ldbg.net/
- Official site: https://ldbg.net/
- Optional Windows app: https://github.com/redredret/redredret.github.io/releases/latest
- Controls: keyboard or controller, every action rebindable. Built for computers, not phones.
- Price: free. Guests can try a local demo; logging in keeps progress on the game's servers.

## The game in numbers

- 221 items, including 85 pieces of gear (helmets, armour, swords, bows, staves, bucklers, rings, necklaces), from 139 crafting recipes
- 30 kinds of monster, 14 of them bosses
- 2 Stories: 19 fights in Greenshore's, then 20 across the Red Desert's 6 locations
- The Endless Dungeon: 13 regions, a world map to plan trips on, and 10 pets to find
- 109 upgrades across 3 upgrade trees (Combat, Skills and Build)
- 86 quests from 8 townsfolk, and 97 daily and weekly tasks
- Live totals, read 2026-11-18: 25 adventurers, 8,357 monsters slain, 2,653 bosses slain, 3,370 Quads and 1,891 T-spins cleared, 1,690 Farm runs

## The Farm

The Farm is an endless run. Clear lines to gather logs, ore, fish and fibre, then craft with them. Quads, T-spins and combos gather more.

- **Farm Solo**: Play on your own. Garbage rises every few pieces, so keep clearing.
- **Farm Versus**: Up to ten players in a room, sending garbage at each other. You keep everything you gather.
- **Dark Farm**: Versus for stakes. Half of everything you gather goes in a pot, and the winner takes it.

## Crafting and gear

Smelt ore into ingots and weave fibre into fabric, then craft 85 pieces of gear from 139 recipes. Everything you wear shows on your character. Trade the rest with other players on the Market for Gold.

## Dungeons

Greenshore's story runs 19 fights long, from zombies on the shore to the Cult Leader at the top of the tower. Beat him and the Red Desert opens, with 20 more fights across 6 places, ending with the Unbound in the Hellish Desert. Your lines are your attacks, and theirs land on your board. Arrows knock out blocks, fire spreads along the bottom row, a worm chomps your tower and a mummy shuts your HOLD.

- **Story**: Two set routes through every area and boss. Greenshore's comes first, then the Red Desert's.
- **The Endless Dungeon**: 13 regions, from Greenshore's fields to the Hellish Desert. The desert's open once you have finished its Story. Plan a trip place by place on the world map, or just wander. The deeper you go, the better the chests.
- **With a Friend**: Take a friend into the Endless Dungeon. You fight the same monster, share every kill, and can pick each other up when one of you goes down.
- **Dark Endless**: DANGER. A riskier, more rewarding endless dungeon. Fight other players for their gear, and higher monster drop rates, while risking your gear.
- **The Garbage Man**: 10 waves of garbage, faster every wave. One top-out ends it.
- **The Slime King**: A king after every king, alone or with a friend. He walls your board down to four columns until he falls. A Slime Key opens his door.

## Bosses

- **Bandit King**: Switches between arrow rain and a blade spin that cuts your top and bottom rows.
- **Cyclops**: Knocks blocks loose from the top of your stack, then sets it on fire.
- **Punchy**: Slams the ground, and a stone wave sweeps across one of your rows.
- **Shooty**: Hurls boulders that drop three or four stone blocks onto your board.
- **Bernie**: A fire-casting cyclops whose fireball spreads along your bottom row.
- **Cult Leader**: Opens portals and hurls fireballs, then shields itself from your next hit.
- **The Garbage Man**: Throws garbage at you one line at a time, faster every wave. Beat wave ten for an Arcane Vault, then keep going.
- **The Slime King**: Walls your board down to four columns, slimes your tower and wraps you up until you shake him off. Beat him and a bigger one comes for you.
- **Desert Worm**: A giant worm that chomps blocks out of your tower to heal, then burrows through it. While it's under, only a clear across its trail can hit it.
- **Scrap Warlord**: Pays his crew to shoot your board, then spins into a dust devil that rips at the sides of your tower until you hit him.
- **Possessed Sarcophagus**: Seals your deepest well with a stone, lets spirits loose on your tower, and raises the dead to take your hits for it.
- **Sandstone Golem**: Cracks your stack, blinds your queue with dust and makes your pieces heavy. Clear his crack or T-spin into his gap to stun him.
- **The Old Man**: The Sand Veil keep him chained at the bottom of their dig. They have studied him for years and never let him die. He doesn't fight back.
- **The Unbound**: A demon from the gate. He lights a ward on your stack to fill, rewrites your next pieces and demands three clears in a row. Miss them and a row of hell-iron rises that takes two clears to break.

## Lesser foes

- **Zombie**: Swipes a block off your top.
- **Super Zombie**: Rakes off two or three.
- **Slime**: Slimes your piece. No rotating.
- **Squirrel**: Bites you, but leaves your board alone.
- **Bandit**: Arrows knock out a block.
- **Bandit Elite**: A tougher bandit, crossbow and all.
- **Cultist**: Fireballs, and a stab at your bottom row.
- **Oak Entling**: A tree stump that grows blocks on your stack.
- **Sand Zombie**: Swipes a block off your top, twice as hard.
- **Wormling**: Bites off a block and heals on it.
- **Raider**: Slashes a block off your top.
- **Mummy**: Binds your HOLD shut until you hit it twice.
- **Rockling**: Heaves stones onto your tallest column.
- **Cave Spider**: Lays an egg on your stack. Clear it before it hatches.
- **Sand Veil Cultist**: Brands blocks to flare unless you clear them.
- **Lesser Cult Leader**: Sun portals, a ring of blocks, and a shield only a spin breaks.

## The Arena

Pick an opponent, check their gear, then fight for fun or for a piece of their gear. Better stacking wins.

## Questions

### What is LDBG?

LDBG is a free falling-block RPG you play in your browser. Every line you clear is an attack on the monster in front of you. Gather materials on the Farm, craft gear, fight through the Greenshore and Red Desert Stories, push into the Endless Dungeon and duel other players. Your account keeps your levels, gear and loot.

### Is LDBG free to play?

Yes. LDBG is free and plays in your browser at play.ldbg.net. Try it as a guest, or log in to keep everything you earn.

### Do I need to download anything?

No. It runs in a desktop browser such as Chrome, Edge or Firefox. There is also an optional Windows app that opens the same game in its own window, with extra settings like higher frame rates.

### What do I play it with?

A keyboard or a controller, on a computer. Every control can be rebound in Settings, and handling such as auto-repeat and soft drop speed can be tuned the way competitive stackers like it.

### Can I play on my phone?

Not yet. LDBG needs a keyboard or a controller, so play it on a computer. Touch controls are planned.

### How does the RPG side work?

Clearing lines gathers logs, ore, fish and fibre on the Farm, or deals damage in a dungeon. Bigger clears hit harder, and Quads, T-spins and combos all pay extra. You earn XP and levels, spend points across 3 upgrade trees, craft gear and improve it at the Forge, finish quests, daily tasks and bounties, find pets, and open reward chests.

### Can I play with friends?

Yes. Farm Versus seats up to ten players who send garbage at each other. In Dark Farm, half of what you gather goes in a pot for the winner. You can fight the Endless Dungeon and the Slime King with a friend, and duel other players in the Arena for fun or for each other's gear. Add friends in the game to see when they're on and invite them in.

### Is my progress saved?

Yes. When you log in, your progress is kept on the game's servers and follows you to any computer. It stays through the beta, so nothing you earn now will be wiped. Guest play is a short local demo, and nothing earned as a guest moves to an account.

### Is LDBG finished?

No, it's in early beta and grows every week. New dungeons, bosses, gear and modes come often. The Recently Added list on this page shows the latest.

## Recently added

- 2026-11-24, **Mummies' bandages come loose faster**: Mummies' bandages now come loose after a single hit.
• One hit on a Mummy frees your HOLD box, not two
• In the Story, the Endless Dungeon and co-op
• Runs you started before this keep the old rules
- 2026-11-24, **Ancient Coke can be traded**: The Ancient Mask's materials have swapped places.
• Ancient Coke can now be traded on the Market
• Perfect Orichalcum is now bound to whoever finds it
• The Ancient Mask takes two Ancient Coke and one Perfect Orichalcum
- 2026-11-23, **Your attacks, reworked**: Every weapon got a new set of attacks.
• Swords, bows and staves change move from hit to hit, and a combo walks through them
• Big clears hit big: a leaping slam, a whirlwind, a volley of arrows, a beam from the staff
• A spin sets your weapon burning in the colour of the piece you spun
• A long combo makes your blade glow hot, and it smokes when the combo ends
• An All Clear has a move of its own for each weapon
• Other players in duels and co-op use the new attacks too
- 2026-11-21, **Ranked Farm**: Climb seven ranks, Coal to Darkite, one on one in the Farm.
• Opens at level 20, from the Farm's mode menu
• Best of 3, just stacking: no skills, gear or head start on the board
• Pay your rank's fee; win, and the Stack multiplies the pot you both gathered, up to ×100
• Five placement matches, then your rank, Grade and Top %
• Season rewards, a ladder, match history and friends to watch
- 2026-11-21, **More Sand Zombies, and Coke from Mummies**: The Endless Dungeon's Pyramids are half Sand Zombies now.
• About one fight in two is a Sand Zombie, the rest Mummies
• Mummies can drop Ancient Coke, about 1 in 500 kills
• The Possessed Sarcophagus still drops it too
- 2026-11-20, **Endless regions open one by one**: Each Endless Dungeon region now opens when you complete it in the Story.
• Complete Greenshore Fields to open the Endless Dungeon
• You don't need to finish the whole Story first
• It counts even if you die later in the run
• Dark and the Red Desert still need the whole Greenshore Story
• Hover a locked place on the map to see what opens it
- 2026-11-20, **Sand Zombies in the Endless Pyramids**: Sand Zombies are back in the Endless Dungeon's Pyramids.
• About one fight in seven between the Mummies, at the Pyramids' strength
• When a chart takes you somewhere, the board says whose chart it was and where it took you
• In co-op too
- 2026-11-19, **Terms, privacy and a Store page**: LDBG now has Terms of Service, a Privacy Policy and a Store page.
• Find them at the bottom of this page, and in the game under Settings > About
• The game asks you to agree to them the next time you log in
• The Store page shows the Prismatic and Void Ornament Kits, their prices and how buying works
